summary.intent: Continue orchestrated multi-wave execution of CipherBox phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration) by validating the just-completed Wave 1 plan (owned write-body foundation) and launching Wave 2.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 plan 68.1-01 completed and verified (5 commits, 266/266 sdk tests passing, STATE/ROADMAP/REQUIREMENTS updated to 2/14 plans); post-merge build/test/drift gates passed and Wave 2 (plan 02) was launched.

repo: packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts (not client.ts) hosts the deleteToBin/restoreFromBin publish calls, so write-key/write-body threading work must touch that file even when a plan's file list only mentions client.ts.
FolderState now has a required writeKey field; existing unit test fixtures (helpers.ts, bin.test.ts) were updated to use a zero-key legacy path to preserve no-network publish behavior in tests.
CipherBoxClientConfig.rootWriteKey is optional, mirroring rootIpnsKeypair — self-bootstrap needs both keys but full host wiring for rootWriteKey is deferred to phase 68.1-03.
workflow: GSD wave-close sequence used by the orchestrator: spot-check the plan SUMMARY, run wave:post hooks/build gate, run scoped post-merge test gate, run wave:post drift gate checks, then a pre-wave dependency key-links check across upcoming plans before launching the next wave's executor agent.

friction: Plan 68.1-01's stated file list was inaccurate — write-key threading actually required editing packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts, an unlisted file, discovered only during execution (auto-fixed under Rule 3).
open_items: Host wiring for CipherBoxClientConfig.rootWriteKey self-bootstrap is deferred to plan 68.1-03.
Wave 2 (plan 02 of phase 68.1) was just launched and is still in progress as of this transcript's end.
